vibe_rationale: Real contemporary art scene with a curated gallery program, but a collector-led commercial fair carried by finance sponsors, so subculture is not the core.
fit_notes: Adult collector and art-going audience with weak wellness adjacency, though a wellness lounge or collab product would sit well. Non-endemic partners (a bank, an investing app, BCA) show brands are welcome. Activation is in Jakarta, so an Australian brand would need a local partner.
